newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer on Friday due to scattered short-covering amid a view that prices were too low after continued price declines since the start of the week, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 yen to 1.1 yen per kg firmer. Benchmark September was up 0.9 yen at 149.5 yen.

The market opened mostly firmer even though traders said sentiment was bearish and there were no bullish factors in sight. "Private investors will be quick to take profits on any price rebound. Expectations that rubber stocks will climb again are casting a shadow over the market," one trader said.
